title: Dr. Bettina Palazzo (business ethics expert, 2024 ICA Compliance Influencer) — 'Nothing new under the sun': Sol Price's 1975 employee promises rediscovered
summary: Business ethics expert Dr. Bettina Palazzo — Palazzo Ethics Advisory, 2024 ICA Compliance Influencer of the Year — pulls Sol Price's 1975 statement of employee promises from Incorruptible and asks whether it's a recent purpose-driven company or a compliance-culture email. Neither: it's 50 years old. Her takeaway is that the ethical-company playbook has been proven for a century, only to be kidnapped by mainstream capitalism.
blockquote: All of those ideas about more ethical companies have been with us for at least 100 years. And most of those companies were highly successful - until they somehow got kidnapped by mainstream capitalism and perished.
